P.name: Prowl
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Prowl:}} While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Nidalee''' gains {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while facing a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champion}} within 1400 range. The bonuses persist for 2 seconds after leaving brush.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Hunt:}} Hitting enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|monsters}} with ''{{ai|Javelin Toss|Nidalee}}'' or ''{{ai|Bushwhack|Nidalee}}'' applies a ''Hunted'' mark to the target for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} as well as grant {{tip|sight}} of a 300-unit radius around them. If '''Nidalee''' is nearby when the target is hit, she gains {{tip|ghosting}} and {{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}} for 4 seconds, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while she is facing a ''Hunted'' target. Additionally, the first cast of both ''{{ai|Takedown|Nidalee}}'' and ''{{ai|Pounce|Nidalee}}'' against a ''Hunted'' target is enhanced.
P.description3: The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} from ''Prowl'' and ''Hunt'' can stack, but cannot exceed {{as|30%|ms}}.

Q.name: Javelin Toss
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' hurls a javelin in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|0 to 225 for 6|525 to 1300}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 150}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|70*3.25 to 150*3.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*3.25}}% AP)}}}}

Q.name: Takedown
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 10 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}} that is increased by an amount for every {{as|1% of the target's '''missing''' health}}.

''Takedown'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Nidalee|crit_base}}|100|base = 100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
Q.description2: {{sbc|''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunt}}'' Bonus:}} Hitting a ''Hunted'' target {{ccs|increases|magic}} ''Takedown's'' damage by 30%.
Q.description3: ''Takedown {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nidalee's''' basic attack timer. Other damage converted to {{as|magic damage}} by Takedown are not increased by Takedown's respective effects. '''Nidalee''' loses Takedown's empowered attack immediately when she switches to {{ai|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee|Human Form}}.''

W.name: Bushwhack
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' lays a trap at the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over {{fd|1.5}} seconds, lasting for up to 120 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} within its radius. The trap will spring upon contact with an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every second over 4 seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|10*4 to 50*4}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
W.description2: Traps have {{as|{{sti|health|6 '''maximum''' health}}}} and can only be damaged by champion [[basic attacks]] (2 hit points from {{tip|ranged}} and 3 hit points from {{tip|melee}}). Up to a maximum of {{pp|4 to 10 for 4|1 to 16}} traps may be active at once.

W.name: Pounce
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Killing an enemy while in ''Cougar Form'' or using ''Pounce's Hunt'' bonus reduces ''Pounce's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} to a minimum value.
W.leveling:
{{sbc|''{{ai|Pounce|Nidalee}}'' scales with ''{{ais|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee}}'' rank}}
{{st|Reduced Cooldown|{{tt|{{ap|3 to 1.5 4}} seconds|Affected by ability haste}}}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} a fixed distance in the target direction. Upon arrival, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
W.description3: {{sbc|''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' Bonus:}} '''Nidalee''' can perform ''Pounce'' from an increased range on a ''Hunted'' enemy closest to the cursor. She will leap to the front of the target.
W.description4: ''{{ai|Takedown|Nidalee}} and {{ai|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee}} can be cast during the dash.''

E.name: Primal Surge
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' revitalizes herself or the target allied champion, granting the target {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 7 seconds and {{tip|healing}} them for an amount that is increased by {{as|{{pp|label1=target's '''missing''' health|label=Heal increase|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 95|formula=1% per 0.95% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}.
E.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 70}}%}}
{{st|Minimum Heal|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|50*2 to 150*2}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}

E.name: Swipe
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' slashes in an arc in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
E.leveling:
{{sbc|''{{ai|Swipe|Nidalee}}'' scales with ''{{ais|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee}}'' rank}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 250 4}} {{as|(+ 70% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}}}

R.name: Aspect of the Cougar
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' switches between her {{sbc|Human Form}} and {{sbc|Cougar Form}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Cougar Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a cougar, gaining {{tip|melee}} attacks with {{sti|range|125 range}} and access to her cougar abilities.
R.description3: {{sbc|Human Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} attacks with {{sti|range|525 range}} and access to her human abilities. While in this form, applying a ''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' mark will reset ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
R.description5: '''Nidalee''' begins with one rank in ''Aspect of the Cougar'' and can increase it at levels 6, 11, and 16. {{sbc|Cougar Form's}} abilities scale based on ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' rank.

R.description2: {{sbc|Cougar Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a cougar, gaining {{tip|melee}} attacks with {{sti|range|125 range}} and access to her cougar abilities.
R.description3: {{sbc|Human Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} attacks with {{sti|range|525 range}} and access to her human abilities. While in this form, applying a ''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' mark will reset ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
R.description5: '''Nidalee''' begins with one rank in ''Aspect of the Cougar'' and can increase it at levels 6, 11, and 16. {{sbc|Cougar Form's}} abilities scale based on ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' rank.
